anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.text:
gauntlet: question
Which behavior should the workspace-switch filter policy default to in the settings resolver (settings/resolver.ts:12)?
A) clear all filters on every workspace switch
B) preserve all active filters across switches
C) restore each workspace's last filters
Recommendation: B - The workspace-change handler in ui/report-view.ts already keeps active filters. Defaulting to preserve changes nothing for current users. It also needs no new per-workspace filter state.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.text:
gauntlet: question
What should happen to the report view’s filters when the workspace changes?
A) Clear all filters on every workspace switch.
B) Preserve all active filters across workspace switches.
C) Restore each workspace’s last filters.
Recommendation: B - it preserves current behavior and fits the existing settings resolver without adding per-workspace filter storage.
